name: Checkbox
looksLike: little square you tick next to a choice
boxes that let me pick several options
square with a check mark when selected
definition: A control that records a checked or unchecked choice. Several checkboxes can be selected independently.
whenToUse: Agreeing to terms in a form

notConfusedWith.difference: Usually applies an on/off setting immediately rather than collecting a form choice.

prompts.short: Add a checkbox with a clickable label and keyboard toggling.
prompts.detailed: Add a native checkbox with an associated visible label and a clickable label area at least 44px high. Let Space toggle it, keep its focus indicator visible, and group related choices with fieldset and legend.

a11yNotes: Associate the checkbox with its label
Support Space to toggle and show keyboard focus
Use fieldset and legend for related choices
